_register: FR register, decided in the 2026-08-18 French review. Marketing and recruitment copy addresses the reader with « tu » (« Rejoins le Wolfpack », « Suis-nous ») because that is how Quebec student organizations speak to students. Legal, contact and incident-report copy stays with « vous » — /privacy, /contact and /report are deliberate exceptions, not misses. Keep new strings on the right side of that line.
_review: Reviewed 2026-08-18. Open question for the exec: « Comité des compétitions John Molson » is our own name for ourselves and is left as-is. Concordia's official French for the school is « École de gestion John-Molson », hyphenated, and Quebec convention would hyphenate ours the same way. Changing how JMCC names itself is the exec's call, not a translator's.
